purpose: Reusable loudspeaker/subwoofer definition suitable for manufacturer libraries and custom user models

data.type: point-source | line-array-element | subwoofer | column | monitor | custom

rules: library definitions are data, not application code
manufacturer folders are organizational only and do not affect acoustic semantics
the library may contain home, studio, installation and PA products without architectural separation
custom and generic models are first-class definitions
one SpeakerModel may be referenced by any number of Speaker instances
frequency range is model data, not a global solver limit
missing manufacturer data must not be fabricated as measured truth
simple coverage data may coexist with higher-resolution polar data
speaker model data remains independent of S3D rendering
